title: tieghemopanax sambucifolius
intro: Tieghemopanax sambucifolius, commonly known as Sambucifolia, is a plant species in the family Araliaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. Bioactive constituents of Tieghemopanax sambucifolius include sesquiterpenes, phenolic compounds, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
